text: However, if we tell the code how some eikonal propagators can be brought into a quadratic form, then an explicit mapping can be found

toposNew = FCLoopReplaceQuadraticEikonalPropagators[{topoEik1, topoEik2}, LoopMomenta -> {k1, k2}, InitialSubstitutions -> { ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[k1 - k2]] -> SPD[k1 - k2], ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[k1 + k2]] -> SPD[k1 + k2]}, IntermediateSubstitutions -> {SPD[n] -> 0, SPD[nb] -> 0, SPD[n, nb] -> 2}];
